purpose: The channels that do not reach the 44px physical-pixel touch floor at the time this contract was written, and whose repair belongs to an owner WO-INV-03 may not write. Every row is a live defect: at the 15px fluid root a 2.75rem floor is 41.25px, on exactly the coarse-pointer devices the floor exists for. This is a named record of routed debt, not an exemption table and not a ratchet — the gate carries no ratchet: and no debtRatio.
owner: WO-INV-03 records; the derivation lane owns the artifact-emitted class and the notification-center family owner owns the authored-fallback row.
provenance: db759703a 2026-09-22 — node scripts/check/touch-target-floor/index.mjs --check, measured over the base entrypoint's import graph plus facade/artifacts/{bithire,evnto,rottay}/index.css. Every row fails identically in all three verticals.
retire: A row is deleted the moment its channel reaches the floor — the gate FAILS on a stale row, so the ledger cannot outlive the debt. The file is deleted when rows is empty. The artifact-emitted class retires when the emitter states a physical pixel length instead of a rem, which rides the Option-A lowering packet (debrief v3 section 5.2); the authored-fallback row retires when the skin's fallback names the canonical channel.
